tip.en: It took ~2 minutes to reach 131 bpm — your cardiac lag today was longer than usual. On flat recent runs your HR locked in faster; the gentle uphill here drew it out slowly, which likely kept your early effort honest.
tip.zh: 约2分钟后心率才升至131次/分，今天的心脏预热比平时更慢。近期平路跑步心率锁定更快，这里的缓上坡让你前期节奏保持得恰到好处。

tip.en: Grade jumps from flat to 7% here and holds for ~200m, yet HR barely budges (125–130 bpm). That's well below your recent trail HR of 139 avg — your legs are absorbing the work your heart isn't yet registering. Good sign for pacing, but watch cadence on this surface.
tip.zh: 坡度从平路骤升至7%并持续约200米，但心率几乎没动（125–130次/分）。这远低于近期越野跑平均139次/分——腿部在承担心脏尚未感知的负荷。配速控制良好，但需注意在这种路面保持步频。

tip.en: A -10% pitch at 3:50 pace with HR only 129 — you flew downhill while your heart barely noticed. This is the fastest moment of the run but it's the mechanical load on quads and ankles that matters here. After recent flat-road runs, your downhill form hasn't been tested; stay controlled rather than chasing the speed.
tip.zh: 在-10%坡度上跑出3:50配速，心率仅129次/分——你飞速下坡，心脏几乎无感。这是全程最快时刻，但真正需要关注的是股四头肌和踝关节的承受。近期多为平路，下坡技术未经考验，保持控制比追速度更重要。

tip.en: Pace slows to 10:49–11:16 around 1.7 km — this looks like a navigation check or a brief stop on the trail. HR dips to 129 and then rebounds. Not a fitness concern, but worth noting: you recovered quickly and held 131 for the next kilometer without issue.
tip.zh: 约1.7公里处配速降至10:49–11:16，像是查看路线或短暂停步。心率降至129后迅速回升。这不是体能问题，但值得留意：你恢复很快，接下来一公里心率平稳保持在131左右。

title.en: Second Climb Begins — HR Creeping Up
title.zh: 第二段爬升启动——心率悄然上升

tip.en: At 2.2 km the grade ticks up and HR crosses 140 for the first time. This is the start of a sustained 1.1 km climb that will push you to your session ceiling. Your avg HR in recent runs is 139 — you're now entering that zone on a gradual build rather than a spike, which is the right way to arrive here.
tip.zh: 2.2公里处坡度上升，心率首次突破140次/分。这是一段持续1.1公里爬升的开始，将把你推向本次训练的上限。近期跑步平均心率139次/分——你现在正以渐进而非骤升的方式进入该区间，这是正确的到达方式。

title.en: Hardest Sustained Effort of the Run
title.zh: 全程最艰难的持续发力

tip.en: HR holds 153 for nearly 20 consecutive seconds across a 6–7% grade at 3.1 km — the longest time above 150 in this session and unusually high for a run where your avg is only 134. This stretch separates today's Bluff Trail from your recent flat runs; the aerobic demand is genuinely different.
tip.zh: 3.1公里处，心率在6–7%坡度上连续近20秒保持153次/分——本次训练中超过150次/分的最长持续段，对于全程平均仅134次/分的跑步来说相当高。这段路真正区分了今天的崖道与近期平路跑步的有氧需求差异。

tip.en: HR peaks at 154 on a ~9% grade and pace immediately collapses to >8 min/km, then beyond 20 min/km — essentially a walk. This is the steepest pitch at the end of a 4.3 km run with 51m gain; your legs gave what they had. For next time, consider banking a bit more energy in the second-climb descent so you can run this last ramp rather than grind it.
tip.zh: 心率在约9%坡度上到达154次/分峰值，配速随即崩塌至8分钟/公里以上，最终超过20分钟/公里——基本变成步行。这是4.3公里、51米爬升后的最陡路段；腿力已经榨干。下次可以考虑在第二段下坡时多储存一些能量，争取跑完最后这段坡而不是硬撑。
